$comment: BLIK Level 0. The transaction is created only when the payer submits a code; HTTP 204 from the code endpoint only means the bank was asked to confirm. Success comes exclusively from a transaction status read from the API.
collapseDuplicates: The API may list BLIK twice (redirect BLIK and Level 0); the SDK shows one BLIK entry, first on the list.

request.note: The key T6 is upper case.

code.logging: A code is never logged, printed or kept after it was sent.

afterSubmit.transaction: abandoned; the next code creates a new transaction
kept; the next code is sent to it

rejectionLimit.note: 5, as MAX_BLIK_REJECTIONS in the Android SDK.
